x: Frank Halls, so we learn, was wounded in the legs before his capture. It is feared that he will not be able to race-walk again, but we hope that the prophets are wrong.

News continues to come from Frank Halls who is wounded and a prisoner in Italy, and Arthur Beales, a prisoner in Germany. News also continues to flow in from all parts of the world of our walkers in the Services.

Alf Miller and Arthur Beales were at Stalagluft III at Sagan and were both in good health. Frank Halls was at Stalag 344 at Lansdorf, and his latest news was that his leg was making progress and that he was in good health.
Norman Dyne, Frank Halls and others. As far as conditions would permit, our Service members came from all parts of the country to help build up the teams.
Alec and Dan Patience are now out of the Army and will be turning up on the Common. Frank Halls reports progress with his leg, Arthur Beales' chief trouble is indigestion.

FRANK HALLS was wounded in the legs before capture and it is feared that he will not beable to race walk again. DAN & ALEC PATIENCE were taken prisoners during the fighting around the Anzio beachhead and sent to Germany.(Dan had earlier been wounded in N.

Coupled with this were a tie with his club mate, F. Halls, in the Surrey W.C. promotion from our headquarters on 27th December, 2nd place in a club handicap on 29th November, and first in the club handicap on 7th February.
